steps.en: Notices that already have a permanent suspension are revived automatically.
steps.id: Notice yang sudah punya permanent suspension di-revive otomatis.

steps.en: The old permanent suspension is closed but its record stays.
steps.id: Permanent suspension lama ditutup tetapi catatannya tetap ada.

steps.en: The new code is applied as a new record next to the old one.
steps.id: Code baru diterapkan sebagai record baru di samping yang lama.

steps.en: The system also closes an old suspension itself before adding the new one.
steps.id: Sistem juga me-revive suspension lama sendiri sebelum menerapkan yang baru.
steps.why_en: A failure while closing the old suspension is only logged, so two active suspensions can remain without any warning.
steps.why_id: Kegagalan menutup suspension lama hanya dicatat di log, sehingga dua suspension aktif bisa tersisa tanpa peringatan.

steps.en: This works for every existing permanent suspension, also on paid notices.
steps.id: Ini berlaku untuk setiap permanent suspension yang ada, juga pada notice yang sudah dibayar.
steps.why_en: For paid notices only two codes can be chosen from the screen and other codes are refused.
steps.why_id: Untuk notice yang sudah dibayar hanya dua code yang bisa dipilih dari layar dan code lain ditolak.

steps.en: Closing the old suspension and adding the new one succeed or fail together.
steps.id: Menutup suspension lama dan menambah yang baru terjadi bersamaan atau tidak sama sekali.
steps.why_en: They are two separate requests; if the second fails, the old suspension stays closed and the notice ends with none.
steps.why_id: Keduanya dua request terpisah; jika yang kedua gagal, suspension lama tetap tertutup dan notice tidak punya suspension.
